answer: The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own oasis record, and its own share of the saffron quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The beacon ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 956 identities would post 3047 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
